label: Diagnosis shock and emotional distress
description: Posts where people describe being devastated, overwhelmed, crying, scared, or in shock after being diagnosed with type 2 diabetes.

label: Shame, guilt, and stigma about type 2
description: Posts about feeling ashamed, guilty, blamed, or judged for having type 2 diabetes, including being treated as if it is their fault or a 'lifestyle disease'.

label: Lifestyle change: diet and exercise
description: Posts focused on changing diet (low-carb, keto, cutting sugar) and exercise to improve blood sugar or overall health.

label: Weight loss and body changes
description: Posts about losing weight, wanting to lose weight, or worrying about weight in relation to diabetes control.

label: Metformin experiences and side effects
description: Posts about starting, stopping, or adjusting metformin, including gastrointestinal side effects or switching to extended-release.

label: Insulin fear and escalation
description: Posts where people are afraid of starting insulin, increasing doses, or see insulin as a sign of failure or severe disease.

label: Remission, reversal, and good control
description: Posts about putting type 2 into remission, reversing it, achieving very good A1C, or long-term successful control.

label: Family history and genetic risk
description: Posts about parents or relatives with type 2 diabetes, worries about inheriting it, or asking about genetic vs lifestyle causes.

label: Longevity and life expectancy with type 2
description: Posts asking about how long people can live with type 2 diabetes, examples of older relatives with it, or worries about dying early.

label: Relapse, burnout, and mental load
description: Posts about the mental burden of constant monitoring, relapsing into old habits, diabetes burnout, or struggling to stay on track.
